summary: Nokia filed a Form 6-K with routine managers' transactions under Article 19 of EU MAR. Multiple other senior managers acquired small numbers of Nokia shares at EUR 9.0910 per share on XHEL on 13 August 2026, totaling six, 251, 262, and 2,890 shares respectively. No strategic action, tender, M&A, or board recommendation is present. The filing is a standard insider dealing disclosure, not a special situation. What to watch: none — monitoring insider activity is routine.
